scope.known_conflict: The candidate records a documented fitted 32C owner build; an existing secondary source reports a conflicting 30 mm value. Neither is sufficient to assert the manufacturer's maximum.
scope.research_boundary: Recheck the current exact manufacturer RS9 specification page and at most one exact manufacturer-linked manual or spec sheet. Stop at a decisive exact-model statement; otherwise preserve the conflict and unknown.
excluded: No transfer from other X-LAB models or generations.
No inference from a fitted tire, frame appearance, or secondary listing.
No price, image, other candidate, or published-variant changes.
